vulnerabilities.description: Semantic gap in query understanding - no query expansion or rewriting
vulnerabilities.impact: Low recall for complex scientific queries requiring domain expertise
vulnerabilities.evidence: No query preprocessing beyond basic tokenization in GraphSeedSelector
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Implement query expansion, rewriting, and domain-specific preprocessing

vulnerabilities.description: Fixed chunk size (1500 chars) may split critical information
vulnerabilities.impact: Context fragmentation leading to incomplete or incorrect answers
vulnerabilities.evidence: chunk_text() in ingest_all_documents.py uses hard boundaries
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Implement semantic chunking with sentence boundary awareness

vulnerabilities.description: In-memory graph store lacks persistent knowledge graph
vulnerabilities.impact: Cannot answer complex multi-hop queries requiring entity relationship traversal
vulnerabilities.evidence: GraphIndexStore is in-memory only, no entity extraction pipeline
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Migrate to persistent graph database with entity extraction

vulnerabilities.description: No faithfulness checking before returning answers
vulnerabilities.impact: Scientific inaccuracies in generated content due to hallucinations
vulnerabilities.evidence: No FaithfulnessMetric or grounding verification in pipeline
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Add faithfulness evaluation and context sufficiency checks

vulnerabilities.description: No dynamic context selection based on query complexity
vulnerabilities.impact: Increased latency and cost, reduced answer quality
vulnerabilities.evidence: Fixed top_k retrieval without adaptive selection
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Implement adaptive context selection based on query type

vulnerabilities.impact: False confidence in system performance, undetected edge case failures
vulnerabilities.evidence: No RAGAS-style evaluation (faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision)
